title: A customer's asset and invoice rows are fetched from the server only on first expand, and expand-all fetches at most one request per visible customer
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the report with several customers, with the browser's network activity panel open.
custom_steps:
1. Load the report and note the requests made for the summary rows.
  2. Expand one customer for the first time and watch the network panel.
  3. Collapse and re-expand the same customer without changing filters.
  4. Use the header chevron's expand-all and count the drill-down requests.
custom_expected:
1. Customer summary rows load WITHOUT the asset/invoice detail — the drill-down data is not preloaded.
  2. The first expand of a customer triggers a server fetch for that customer's asset and invoice rows.
  3. Expand-all triggers at most one drill-down fetch per not-yet-expanded customer on the current page — a bounded number never exceeding the page size; it does not fetch customers beyond the current page or the whole result set.
